title: Wezterm ssh closes after some time with "error reading from channel", using libssh backend
body:
### What Operating System(s) are you seeing this problem on?

Windows

### Which Wayland compositor or X11 Window manager(s) are you using?

_No response_

### WezTerm version

20230408-112425-69ae8472 x86_64-pc-windows-msvc

### Did you try the latest nightly build to see if the issue is better (or worse!) than your current version?

No, and I'll explain why below

### To Reproduce

Not sure how ... I just work, and after a while wezterm closes... Maybe logs can give a hint?

Wezterm is running on a PC that I RDP to. Several times I would lock the PC, and when I unlock it, wezterm is gone. Or, wezterm disappears when I switch focus back to it, often by clicking it with a mouse. But, obviously, it does not happen every time...

comments.author: participant5
comments.body:
I was having a similar problem on macOS and couldn't get `wezterm ssh` to work using the `libssh` backend.

The issue resolved itself as soon as I removed the `com.apple.quarantine` file attribute from `Wezterm.app` and all the files within it.

```sh
# list file attributes
xattr -l /Applications/WezTerm.app

# recursively remove quarantine attribute from all files under WezTerm.app
xattr -rd com.apple.quarantine /Applications/WezTerm.app
```

I'd be interested to hear if this helps anyone else – it was a bit of a lucky guess on my part.

comments.author: participant6
comments.body: I'm having the same problem using Linux. I checked the libssh_rs crate (which I believe wezterm is using, if not forget what I am saying), and it seems that send_msg_ignore, the mechanism behind the keep alive didn't make it into the safe rust bindings. The user of libssh (the original one, which are the bindings for) is responsible to send this msg_ignore within the interval which is usually configured in .ssh/config. So, IMHO one fix for this problem would be to add a Parameter to the wezterm ssh config (keep alive), and use this value to send this message cyclical.
